metricsScope: synthetic-teacher-rule holdout only; not empirical flood-model accuracy

training.target: synthetic runoff-load proxy in metres; not observed flood depth
limitations: Synthetic labels are generated by the documented runoff rule in this script.
Holdout metrics measure agreement with that synthetic rule only.
No flood gauge, satellite impact map, road closure, or incident labels are used.
Not calibrated or suitable for operational warnings or emergency dispatch.
